answer: Every new agent locks a 50-unit copper bond in a vault for 20 epochs and names two sponsors on a public graph. Any peer may dispute a suspect with evidence; if it holds, the bond is slashed and each sponsor loses half of theirs. Star-shaped clusters are flagged automatically. Forging 100 identities locks 5,000 units, while one honest agent pays a single bond and earns rewards fakes cannot dilute — the summit stays open only to real stakers.
